name: Emirati Chicken Machboos

components.name: Chicken Machboos
steps: Wash basmati rice and soak 20 minutes while preparing the aromatics. Drain thoroughly.
Melt ghee in a large deep pot; toast cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, bay leaf and bzar briefly without burning.
Add onion and garlic; sauté until golden. Add tomato, ginger, chicken, loomi, measured salt and pepper.
Stir in 1 litre of the water and simmer until chicken is nearly cooked through, about 35 to 50 minutes depending on cut.
Add drained rice and enough of the remaining measured water for the rice to absorb; bring to a steady simmer.
Cover on low heat for around 15 to 20 minutes until rice is tender and chicken is at least 74°C; rest before fluffing.
Portion rice and deboned edible chicken separately if you need accurate per-member protein weights.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Traditional one-pot rice dish. Source gives bone-in chicken and large rice batch. All measured seasonings fixed in this draft.
Storing & reheating: Chill rice rapidly in shallow containers; freeze portions promptly for later-week use.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
